existential.title: Existential
existential.subtitle-2: Presented at the o.art.ath art space
existential.highlight: The exhibition "Existential" was presented at the o.art.ath art space in Athens between June 13-19, 2025. This exhibition was the evolution of "I'm Not Good Enough", combining the piece "I Love Myself".
existential.loveMyself-1: The path to loving myself was long and with many ups and downs. But the journey was beautiful and in the end that's what mattered.
existential.loveMyself-2: I did therapy. I took pills. I went through situations and existential thoughts that I never imagined! I sat with myself a lot. I hugged me and accepted me. I accepted the person I have inside me with all his characteristics.
existential.loveMyself-3: Thanks to all of this, I grew up. I became independent. I learned to be present. I learned to say no. I learned to live for myself and for my own needs. Now my goals and my wants belong to me and I am ecstatic to conquer them.
existential.loveMyself-4: A friend of mine says that we are this little three-year-old child, where our memories begin. This little child that our parents gave birth to and now we are responsible for taking care of. This little child is us! And if we don't love and protect it, no one will.
existential.loveMyself-5: With this little child we were born together and hugging this little child we will die. Only this kid will know our whole being, all our wants, all our memories and all our unfulfilled dreams. Only this kid will accompany us for our whole lives and this kid will have the priority of my care since we will live together once.

notGoodEnough.title: I am not Good Enough
notGoodEnough.subtitle-2: Presented at the Skagiopouleio Foundation of Patras as part of the N+1 Click photography festival of A.S.T.O.-Epikoinonoume
notGoodEnough.highlight: The exhibition "I am Not Good Enough" was presented as part of the first N+1 Click photography festival of A.S.T.O.-Epikoinonoume. It lasted from November 29 to December 8, 2024
notGoodEnough.notGoodEnough-1: I am not good enough… A phrase constantly playing in my head.
notGoodEnough.notGoodEnough-2: I grew up in Kastoria in a caring and loving family. My parents wanted me to excel, wanted me to not go through the things they went through. They helped me, they protected me. They protected me too much...
notGoodEnough.notGoodEnough-3: When I left home, I went to Patras to study. My dream university! I am making my own life now! Or so I thought… Every new step I took was filled with insecurity. I had to take validation from friends, from acquaintances, from my parents. I was not enough to make a decision, I was not enough to dictate my life.
notGoodEnough.notGoodEnough-4: Things soon spiralled out of control. My solution? Perfectionism… only to make things worse. After every try, sadness. After every success, I could have been better. I could have been better. Nothing was good enough… I was not good enough… I was now on my own.
notGoodEnough.notGoodEnough-5: I reached a point where nothing had meaning anymore. I was hopeless, I was alone. I would love to remember my way down there from these photographs.
